standard.name: Minimum Information About a Single Amplified Genome (MISAG)
standard.abstract: Standards for reporting bacterial and archaeal single amplified genomes (SAGs) and metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs). Defines metadata fields to describe sample origin, laboratory processing (e.g., whole genome amplification kits, lysis methods), sequencing and assembly (sequencing method, assembly software, assembly quality), and genome quality metrics (completeness, contamination scores). The recording modality is genomic sequence assemblies and associated structured contextual metadata entries.

classification.rationale: The source is a checklist presented as a metadata table (MIXS terms): each row names a specific metadata field with cardinality, a concrete data type (String, Integer, Boolean, Datetime, Enum), and a description — i.e., genuine field-level structure rather than prose guidance.
